correctness.rationale: Direct generator multiplication and root-syndrome nullspace each exhaust exactly 2^16 distinct codewords; all 31 integer weight rows agree exactly. The proof of b=9..15 uses the independently checked fourteen rank-13 columns and exact endpoint counts, and b=5..16 MDS is based on d_5=20 exhaustive lower bound plus explicit generator witness and window monotonicity. Computational finite certificate is included in complete standalone source files; no extrapolation to other lengths.
